options.say: That's what a claim jumper says.
options.repeat: Still what they say. Word for word, usually.

options.say: Never heard of him. Is he rich? Then he's a jumper too.
options.repeat: Never heard of him. Nobody here has. We don't take names, we take claims.

options.say: Proof you've got nothing worth jumping for. A man with nothing is the only man I trust.
options.repeat: Proof. Of nothing. Bring me nothing, written down.

options.text: Why is everybody here so early?
options.say: Early? We keep the camp's time. The Deacon's watch, in the grog tent. You're the one who's late.
options.repeat: The Deacon's watch says you're late. The Deacon's watch is never wrong.

options.say: I trust a man with nothing. It's men with something I watch.
options.repeat: Nothing's the safest thing to own. Ask anybody here who owns something.

options.say: Rich enough to stand at the bottom of a path all day so nobody takes it.

options.text: Would you like to buy a claim?
options.repeat: Still thinking. That's the first honest offer I've had all year.
